description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the HTML configuration component of the Daux documentation generator, specifically testing the creation of HTML configurations and the 'edit_on_github' link formatting.

classes.name: ConfigTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class testing the configuration setup for the HTML format in the Daux documentation system.

methods.name: testHTMLConfigCreation
methods.description: Tests the creation of an HTML configuration object and verifies its 'edit_on' value.

methods.name: providerEditOn
methods.description: Data provider method supplying various 'edit_on_github' and 'edit_on' configurations for testing.

methods.name: testEditOn
methods.description: Parameterized test that verifies the 'edit_on' URL formatting and handling across different input scenarios.
